missionPremise: WDLL item 4 (P-50 PE): inspect cites well-fact from cortex-root wellFact. Cortex already serving (item 4 cortex half met). Gold 48021:34137 is live state=refused code=atom-miss source=well-fact. Bastrop 48021 has zero well-fact rows. Present fixture only is Crane 48103:100 entityId=48103:100:42000001030000 parcelRelation=on-parcel apiNumber14=42000001030000 wellStatus=dry operatorName null. Live cortex GET of Crane is HTTP 404 not_baked — a bake hole, not a well miss. Do not use Crane as the live PE probe. Wells are a spatial overlay at WRITE time. Writer keys ${parcel}:${wellKey}. Do not copy the special-district :sd: picker. Do not copy pipeline ANY bind. Do not share the texas-rrc key. This card implements against fixtures. No deploy. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-22_serve-pe-p50_dispatch.md; _inbox/2026-08-22_p50_cortex_execute.json; hauska-map PR 178 at ec6a62c.
completionPredicate: mergeBakedBaseFacts copies a fixture wellFact from the cortex JSON ROOT onto the atom-chain payload and does not copy bake / CAD / texas-rrc GIS / tx_rrc_well onto that field. A missing field stays missing. Early return with no facets still attaches the root field. Inspect Well row reads wellFact only. Gold-shaped atom-miss fixture does not render a well, apiNumber14, or :none. Present fixture 48103:100 shows apiNumber14=42000001030000. Typed absent (stored :none, e.g. 48103:104) stays visible. fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias retries when wellFact is missing even if flood / land-use / special-district / pipeline are already present. Integer gold is the live probe; Crane 48103:100 live 404 is a bake hole not a well miss. texas-rrc stays live:false. Diff uncommitted. No deploy.
scopeBasis: PE BFF copy plus inspect Well row / resolver. Cortex owns the atom read (already serving). Live inspect is atom-chain-warm so mergeBakedBaseFacts is the live path. Do not adopt bake / CAD / texas-rrc GIS / tx_rrc_well as wellFact. Do not invent apiNumber14, :none, or a well on gold 48021:34137. Do not add a :sd: or :well: picker. Do not copy pipeline ANY bind. Do not start P-51. Do not flip texas-rrc or mud-pid. Do not occupy P:/hauska-map or the property seat checkout. ParcelFactSheet stays frozen on required fields; well is additive optional so stubs do not break.

design.livePath: PROPERTY_ATOM_PATH=1 → fetchAtomChainWithAlias + fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias + mergeBakedBaseFacts(adapted, cortexBody) + echoRequestedParcelNodeId. Cortex-off strip already spreads the root.

copyRule.picker: wellFactFromCortexRoot parallel to pipelineFactFromCortexRoot. No :sd: token parse. No pipeline ANY bind.

alias.rule: fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias retries when floodHazardFact OR landUseFact OR specialDistrictFact OR pipelineFact OR wellFact is missing on a 2xx (or on 404). Return alias only when it fills a root-fact gap.
alias.whyOr: After PR 178, padded gold already carries flood / land-use / special-district / pipeline. A those-only retry never fetches integer wellFact.

resolver.whenRefusedAtomMiss: unresolved with reason that cites well-fact as atom-miss; never apiNumber14; never :none; never a well

adversarialReview.objection: Rename a texas-rrc GIS paint or CAD bake or tx_rrc_well field to wellFact and call that the atom.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch forbids adopting bake / CAD / texas-rrc GIS / tx_rrc_well as that field. Cortex already writes a ROOT sibling from well-fact atoms. Copying GIS would look like a merge win while remaining starved of the atom.
adversarialReview.disposition: ROOT only. Type guard requires state present|absent|refused.

adversarialReview.objection: Paint apiNumber14 / :none / a well on gold 48021:34137 because Crane 48103:100 has that body.
adversarialReview.response: Gold live bind is refused atom-miss. Crane is a present fixture only and its live cortex GET is HTTP 404 not_baked. Painting a well on gold is the defect the dispatch names.
adversarialReview.disposition: Fail closed. Gold atom-miss must not render a well or :none.

adversarialReview.objection: Treat Crane 404 as proof of no well.
adversarialReview.response: The 404 body is error=not_baked errorClass=no_coverage. That is a bake hole, not a well miss. Gold atom-miss still stands.
adversarialReview.disposition: Do not use Crane as the live PE probe.

adversarialReview.objection: Flip texas-rrc live:true because inspect is about to be wired.
adversarialReview.response: Wells do not share that key. Registry emptyBasis says the GIS layer has no source. Overlay fetch is not well-fact.
adversarialReview.disposition: Leave live:false. Say so in the close.

adversarialReview.objection: Copy the special-district :sd: picker or pipeline ANY bind so PE can bind wells by entity_id suffix.
adversarialReview.response: Wells are a spatial overlay at WRITE time. Writer keys ${parcel}:${wellKey}. Dual grammar is parcel prefix only. Cortex already bound the atom. PE copies the interpreted field.
adversarialReview.disposition: No :sd: or :well: picker. No pipeline ANY bind.
